# Third-party notices

This repository redistributes work from the projects below. Each entry keeps its original
licence, its original copyright, and a link back to the source. Nothing here changes the
licence of the original work.

Two tiers, because they carry different guarantees.

## Tier 2: imported before the manifest existed

Hand-copied into the tree before `scripts/sync_vendor.py` existed. Each is attributed and
most carry a licence file in place, but none is commit-pinned or automatically refreshed.
Migrating them to tier 1 is item 5 of the backlog in
[`docs/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md`](./docs/ARCHITECTURE_REVIEW.md). The inventory behind this
table is [`docs/third-party-inventory.json`](./docs/third-party-inventory.json), and
[`scripts/audit_third_party.py`](./scripts/audit_third_party.py) fails CI if a licence or
attribution file appears in the tree without a matching entry.

## If an attribution here is wrong

Open an issue and it gets corrected. Attribution reports are handled before anything else
in this repository. If you are an author listed above and want your work removed, say so
and it will be removed.
